parent_contract.combined_interpretation: the parent mapping contract and this event/provenance extension together form the locked U3 B2 contract

fvm_extension.right_boundary_scaffold: TransmissiveBoundary used only to construct finite ghost states; its external numerical flux is discarded and replaced before all budgets and updates

acoustic_event_detection.candidate_index_rule: among samples k with k-1 and k+1 inside the expected-time window, select the minimum centered pressure slope; ties select the earliest k

mesh_cfl_characterization.acceptance_rule: every fixed run must satisfy its predeclared identity, inventory, event-sign, and event-arrival tolerances
mesh_cfl_characterization.claim_limit: characterization only; no formal convergence order, mesh independence, or CFL independence is approved

runtime_and_provenance.analysis_source_git_sha_rule: record github.event.pull_request.head.sha when present, otherwise github.sha
runtime_and_provenance.checkout_git_sha_rule: record git rev-parse HEAD separately from analysis source SHA
runtime_and_provenance.artifact_manifest_rule: artifact_sha256.txt covers every retained evidence file except itself
